race.comment: SIRIUSLY BRIGHT (5) has not raced since she scored over 1200m at Ballarat on June 12. Is lightly raced and looks forward enough after a solid recent trial. Everything points to a big run. ADIEU GRASSE (3) hasn't done a whole lot wrong in four starts this time in, never finishing further back than fourth. Has the ability to put himself on speed, which can be an advantage here, just needs a little luck from the wide draw. STRIKE GOLD (4) was below his best last time, finishing sixth and beaten 2.5 lengths over 1200m at Echuca after being in the firing line on the turn. Best figures measure up nicely, though, so can hit back. ELENA MONTERO (6) is a classy type who is trained on the track and should be ready to fire now after a couple of runs back.
